# People Audit

## Purpose
Assess the state of the People department in the whole system: how well talent acquisition, HR processes, and recruiting hold together, and where they are weak.

## Scope
- Talent acquisition and recruiting funnel
- HR processes and benchmarks
- Onboarding and offboarding
- Roles, expectations, and accountability
- Team health and retention

## What is in place
- [ ] Recruiting funnel where every stage has numbers
- [ ] HR processes that refer to their benchmarks
- [ ] Role descriptions with clear expectations and owners
- [ ] Onboarding that gets a new person to real work
- [ ] Record of people, roles, and processes in one place

## Gaps
- [ ] Funnel stages with no numbers behind them
- [ ] HR processes with no benchmark to check against
- [ ] Roles with unclear ownership or expectations
- [ ] Onboarding that leaves people guessing
- [ ] People decisions living in scattered notes

## Next steps
- Pick the highest priority gap and name its owner
- Add or fix the missing agent, skill, command, or workflow for that gap
- Run the new piece on a real hire or HR process and check the result against evidence
- Record the decision and the outcome in the decision log
- Repeat for the next gap
- Share the finished audit and the changes with the people who need them, so the work reaches distribution
